create_fuyu_image_processor: create a FuyuImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the Fuyu multimodal model
resize_fuyu_images: resize images to fit within target dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio for Fuyu model input
patchify_fuyu_images: patchify a tensor image into flat patches using unfold for Fuyu vision encoder processing
preprocess_with_tokenizer_info: preprocess images with tokenizer info to generate image input ids, patches, and patch indices for variable-sized Fuyu inputs
convert_fuyu_batch_to_tensors: convert a FuyuBatchFeature output to PyTorch tensors with nested list support and device placement
